evidence.observation: nextIndex uses findIndex from zero; each skipped acknowledged entry calls it again. From constraints filter results but do not start traversal at from.

Preserve the exact next-index contract, including partial-block retention and empty/null termination; no persistent pending index.
recommendations.expected_qualitative_effect: Less CPU and iterator overhead for resume/termination pages with large acknowledged suffixes; no reduction in required substantive review, delivered evidence or validation is claimed.

primary.correctness: Keep source verification for every delivered item and the same item order, partial continuation and empty terminal-page semantics.
